Frequently asked questions — Marathahalli

Do you shoot 360° virtual tours in Marathahalli?

Yes. Thamco360’s scan crew travels to businesses and properties across Bangalore, including Marathahalli, and deploys within 48 hours of booking. There is no studio to visit — the crew comes to you.

Can a Marathahalli showroom show its full range in a 360° tour?

Yes. Each section of the showroom floor is captured, so customers can look around the displays and decide what to see before they visit.

Is a tour worth it for a PG in Marathahalli?

Yes. Tenants, many of them relocating for work, can compare rooms and shared facilities from anywhere, which cuts down on wasted visits.

How much does a 360° virtual tour cost in Marathahalli?

Basic Thamco360 packages start from just ₹7,999. The final price depends on the size of the space, the number of scan points and any extras such as a website embed or custom 3D features.
